title: Strings: Indexing, Slicing and Methods
learning_objectives: Index characters with positive and negative indices
Slice substrings, including with a step
Use len(), upper(), lower(), strip(), replace() and the in operator
hints: `word[0]` is the first character and `word[-1]` the last.
`word[:3]` never fails even if the word is shorter; `word[::-1]` reverses it.
`'th' in word` gives True or False; print it inside an f-string.

failure_feedback.advice: Use a slice `word[:3]`; slices stop at the end of the string without errors.
Strip the input before measuring its length.
The test is case-sensitive: use `'th' in word` on the original word.
Use `word[-1]` for the last character and `word[::-1]` to reverse.
